description:
Welcome to Team Ofoq! 🌟 We are an imaginative and passionate team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge under the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge.

Our mission is to bridge history and exploration by giving a "voice" to the legendary rovers, landers, and scientific equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. Through immersive storytelling and interactive design, we are transforming retired space hardware into inspiring stories of human triumph, discovery, and resilience.
